root_cause.text: In the BPF verifier's `adjust_reg_min_max_vals()` function, modifying the destination register in-place before calculating the delta for linked registers results in incorrect delta values when the source and destination registers alias the same `bpf_reg_state`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a guard condition `!(BPF_SRC(insn->code) == BPF_X && insn->src_reg == insn->dst_reg)` to skip the delta tracking logic for self-referential operations, preventing the subsequent `reg_const_value(src_reg)` call from reading the already-modified destination value instead of the original source.

vuln_statements.explanation: Based on the vulnerability root cause describing in-place modification of destination register before delta calculation for linked registers, this statement represents the pattern where dst_reg is modified directly. When src_reg and dst_reg alias the same bpf_reg_state, this in-place modification corrupts the original value needed for correct delta computation in subsequent linked register handling.
